# EPL Matchday 9 - Sat Oct 31

## Pick
- **Chelsea ML vs Man United (+108), 0.5u (8:30 AM ET).** Opta 51.8% and Dimers 51.1% vs 48.1% implied - two models agree, gap ~3.5 pts (well under the 10-pt trust cap). Concrete team news: Man United without Sesko, Rashford, Ugarte, Dorgu and Shaw, winless in eight, manager under pressure. Chelsea also missing Joao Pedro, Reece James and Martinez, so stake small. Adjusted ~50.9% vs 48.1%.

## Leans / passes
- Hull v Ipswich: Opta 45%, Dimers 42% vs +182 (35%) - two models, but no team-news reason found. Lean Hull.
- Man City v Brighton: Dimers City 61.9% but Opta 56.3% vs ~58% market. Split; pass.
- Coventry v Sunderland: Dimers on Sunderland, Opta on Coventry. Pass.
